status: 나그네새 수천 마리 · 여름철새 수백 마리 · 겨울에도 드물게 기록(10건 미만)
habitat: 갯가, 골짜기의 관목, 풀이 우거진 덤불

months.note: 북한 개마고원에서 6~8월 하순에 알을 낳고, 중부 이남에서는 봄과 가을에 지나간다.

summary: 북한 개마고원에서 작은 무리가 번식하는 여름새이며, 중부 이남에서는 봄과 가을에 작은 무리로 지나간다. 지나갈 때는 주로 갯가나 골짜기의 관목, 풀이 우거진 덤불에서 보이고, 가끔 멧새과 새들 틈에 섞이기도 한다. 혼자 또는 암수가 함께 지내며 한배에 알을 3~5개 낳는다. 곤충과 여러 가지 열매를 즐겨 먹는다.

art.subject: Siberian Rubythroat (Calliope calliope), adult male on autumn passage (September–October): forehead to nape dark olive-brown; a long white supercilium and a short white moustachial stripe ending below the cheek, both slightly blurred by dark feather tips; lores and a thin malar line black; chin and throat glossy scarlet-red, narrowly framed black; upperparts, wings and tail plain olive-brown; breast greyish-buff; belly whitish; flanks buff-brown; bill dark brown with a paler base to the lower mandible; brown eye; pale pinkish-brown legs.
art.pose: skulking low in dense grass at the edge of a thicket, side view
art.scene: Korean autumn valley thicket with tall grass beside a stream; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male, side view perched low: dark olive-brown crown and upperparts, long white supercilium, short white moustachial stripe, black lores and malar line, glossy scarlet-red throat, greyish-buff breast, whitish belly, pale pinkish-brown legs

adult female, side view perched: plain olive-brown upperparts, whitish supercilium and moustachial stripe fainter than the male's, white throat (sometimes with a faint pink tinge), no black on the face, buff-brown breast and flanks, pale pinkish-brown legs
art.build: Robust, chat-like bird, about 15.5cm — a little larger and plumper than a sparrow, with a large rounded head; no crest, the crown feathers lie flat. Bill thin, straight and pointed, shorter than the head. Legs fairly long and strong, pale pinkish-brown. Wings short and rounded. Tail medium-length and plain olive-brown, without white or rufous patches. Skulks in dense grass and low scrub, hopping on the ground, and sometimes perches on a low open twig.
avoid: Do not omit the male's ruby-red throat — the mark in both its Korean and English names.
Do not spread the red onto the breast or belly; it is confined to the chin and throat.
Do not paint a blue throat band (Bluethroat) or an orange breast (robin).
Do not paint the female with a red throat or black face marks.
